name: ARPA Road to Recovery Geographic Program Impact

columns.name: Cost Center
columns.description: A unique identifier to differentiate program impact information by program.

columns.name: Department
columns.description: Identified department in the City of Chicago for administering the program.

columns.name: Policy Pillar
columns.description: Alignment of program to policy priority areas of the City of Chicago.

columns.name: Total Served
columns.description: The number of people, entities or locations the program has served in a standardized format, describing the impact of this program on the community.

columns.name: Ending Fiscal Quarter
columns.description: The most recent fiscal quarter included in the window the program is reporting data.

columns.name: Project Name
columns.description: The name for the specific location-based initiative.

columns.name: Applicant Organization
columns.description: The entity which governs the usage of funds awarded to the project.

columns.name: Geographic Category
columns.description: The type of geographic boundary by which a program tracked total served within the city (e.g. Ward, Zip Code).

columns.name: Geography Name
columns.description: The name of the respective geographic category where impact was implemented.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: The address where the project was implemented.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the project’s address.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the project’s address.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The location of the project's address.

columns.name: Boundaries - ZIP Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries - ZIP Codes' (rpca-8um6) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Zip Codes
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Zip Codes' (6mkv-f3dw) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
